noPassword: No password. Use the same nickname next time to find your sessions again.
loginDefault: Enter a nickname. Your sessions are kept under it, so you can leave and continue later, from any browser.
loginStart: Enter a nickname to start a learning session. Your sessions are kept under it, so you can leave and continue later, from any browser.
loginSessions: Enter your nickname to see your sessions and continue one.
openError: This session could not be opened.
skipSetup: Skip the rest of the setup chat
defaultDirection: explore {topic} through explanations, questions, and discussion with your classroom.
peerBasis: A way of thinking about this topic
tutorBelief: “What evidence would help us test these explanations?”
tutorNote: Helps compare assumptions and evidence to build understanding.
peerOneBasis: A common misconception about the topic
peerOneBelief: “Could a simple, everyday explanation account for this?”
peerOneNote: Brings an intuitive perspective for the classroom to examine.
peerTwoNote: Offers a different explanation to compare with your own ideas.
overviewIntro: Meet the participants who will help you explore {topic} from {count} perspectives. The peers are learners like you, so what they say can be wrong. The tutor guides the discussion and will ask you to explain your own understanding; it does not have to be complete or correct.
sessionsError: Your sessions could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
autoAdvanceHint: Off: the next message appears only when you press Next message
speedHint: How fast the next message follows
peerNotice: A peer is a learner like you, not an expert: what they believe can be wrong, and it changes during the discussion.
initialUnchanged: Initial understanding: nothing has changed yet.
updatedAfterTurn: Updated after turn {turn}: show the message
selectParticipant: Select a participant on the left to view their understanding here.
markAccuracy: Mark what is correct and incorrect
pauseOnPanel: Pause the discussion when I open a panel
tutorRole: Guides the discussion: steps in when it stalls or drifts, and gives feedback on your explanations.
adminToken: Admin token (ADMIN_TOKEN in backend/.env on the server)
tokenStorage: The token is kept only in the sessionStorage of this tab and is gone when the tab closes.
notInModelList: Not in the OpenRouter model list.
noApiKey: OPENROUTER_API_KEY is not set on the server.
emptyResets: · Save it empty to go back to the default.
fastModel: Fast model (picks the speaker, updates knowledge states)
modelListError: Could not load the model list:
searchExample: Search (e.g. claude haiku, gpt luna, gemini flash)
savedModel: Saved. The next LLM call uses the new model (calls in flight are not affected).
overrideActive: Override from the admin page is active (kept across restarts).
openRouterSpend: OpenRouter key spend (what is actually billed)
keyInfoError: Could not get the key info from OpenRouter:
keyLimitHint: A per-key limit can be set on OpenRouter
spendNote: Counted by OpenRouter: includes spend from anywhere else this key is used, and may lag a few minutes.
serverLlmCalls: LLM calls from this server (event log)
noCacheData: No call has reported cache figures yet
estimatedCost: ≈ marks costs estimated from list prices for calls where OpenRouter reported no cost.
cacheHitNote: Cache hit rate: input tokens read from the provider's prompt cache, divided by the input tokens of the calls that reported a cache figure (older calls, logged before this was recorded, are left out). Some providers, Anthropic among them, cache only when the request asks for it (cache_control). The csl pipeline's discussion calls do; the baseline, and with it csl's state updates, does not, so those calls show 0%.
cancelledCalls: Turns cancelled midway (prefetched turns dropped when the learner interjects) report no tokens and are missing here. For the exact amount, use the OpenRouter key spend above.
searchSessions: Search by topic or session ID
pickSession: Pick a session from the list.
mockNote: The mock replays a fixed scenario ("Why is summer hotter than winter?") and ignores the topic. It makes no LLM calls and needs no access code.
optionalAccess: Access code (if the server requires one)
accountNote: Sessions you start now are kept under this nickname and can be continued from any browser.
devLoginNote: No password. A new nickname creates an account; a known one signs in to it. Without signing in, a session is only remembered in this browser.
startOnLeft: None yet. Start one on the left.
browserSessions: Sessions started in this browser (not signed in)
browserSessionsNote: This list is kept in this browser only. A session can also be reopened with its link (the address of this page while the session is open).
missingSession: Session {id} does not exist on this server (or this page's origin is not allowed).
tutorWaiting: The tutor is waiting for your explanation. (Resume = skip)
leaveHint: Leaving does not end the session: it pauses, and this page's link or the list on the start page reopens it.
mockModels: The mock pipeline makes no LLM calls, so the models set here are not used. Change PIPELINE in backend/.env and restart the backend.
customModels: The settings below apply only if this pipeline uses get_llm() from app/llm.py.
fastUsesMain: · Fast calls currently go to the main model.
unknownPriceCount: {count} calls with an unknown price are left out.
